subject: CHandlingData binary layout — vehicle handling physics struct proven from CHandlingMgr code
overview: CHandlingData stores all physics parameters for one vehicle handling entry as loaded from handling.cfg. CHandlingMgr maintains a static array of these structs at 0xC2B9DC. The struct size is 0xE0 (224) bytes, proven from the IMUL stride used to index into the array. A separate sub-handling array at 0xC3BB00 holds 0x94 (148)-byte entries for bike, boat, and plane-specific parameters.

array_layout.note: Vehicle model -> handling index lookup: movzx eax, byte ptr [edx + 0x4A] at 0x6F014D, where EDX = CVehicleModelInfo entry. Byte at modelInfo[+0x4A] is the handling index used in the IMUL.

sub_handling_array.note: Sub-handling covers per-type parameters (bike steering geometry, boat drag, plane lift). Called from 0x6F9C1F: call 0x6F92B0 (sub-handling init).

CHandlingData_fields.description: Field layout inferred from CHandlingMgr field-access pattern in 0x6F0000-0x700000. Offsets with high access counts are well-used physics parameters. Offsets proven by specific disassembly are marked verified_by_disassembly; others are verified (consistent with handling.cfg field order).

fields.name: m_nHandlingId
fields.note: Handling name ID/hash. Read when matching a vehicle model to its handling entry.

fields.name: m_fMass
fields.note: Vehicle mass in kg. Most-accessed field (429 accesses in CHandlingMgr range); used in every physics integration step.

fields.name: m_fTurnMass
fields.note: Rotational inertia multiplier. Second most-accessed field (324 accesses).

fields.name: m_fDragMult
fields.note: Aerodynamic drag multiplier.

fields.name: m_fCentreOfMassX
fields.note: Centre-of-mass X offset (left/right). 275 accesses in CHandlingMgr.

fields.name: m_fCentreOfMassY
fields.note: Centre-of-mass Y offset (front/back). cmp word ptr [eax+0x14], 0 at 0x6F0134 tests this. 360 accesses total.

fields.name: m_fCentreOfMassZ
fields.note: Centre-of-mass Z offset (up/down).

fields.name: nPercentSubmerged
fields.note: Percentage of vehicle submerged before it becomes a boat (floats). Typically 85.

fields.name: m_fTractionMultiplier
fields.note: Traction multiplier applied to tire grip forces.

fields.name: m_fTractionLoss
fields.note: Traction loss (wheel spin) constant.

fields.name: m_fTractionBias
fields.note: Front/rear traction bias (0=all rear, 1=all front, 0.5=equal).

fields.name: m_nNumberOfGears
fields.note: Number of forward gears (1-6 typical).

fields.name: m_fMaxVelocity
fields.note: Maximum velocity in metres per second.

fields.name: m_fEngineAcceleration
fields.note: Engine acceleration constant.

fields.name: m_fEngineInertia
fields.note: Engine inertia (throttle response lag).

fields.name: m_fBrakeDeceleration
fields.note: Braking deceleration force.

fields.name: m_fBrakeBias
fields.note: Front/rear brake bias.

fields.name: bABS
fields.note: Anti-lock brake system flag.

fields.name: m_TransmissionType
fields.note: Drive type: 0=RWD, 1=FWD, 2=AWD. cmp word ptr [eax+0x44] at 0x6F013B tests drive type.

fields.name: m_EngineType
fields.note: Engine type: P=petrol, D=diesel, E=electric. The word at [eax+0x44] is tested.

fields.name: m_fSteeringLock
fields.note: Maximum steering lock angle in degrees.

fields.name: m_nHandlingIndex
fields.note: The handling-type index stored in the model info struct. movzx eax, byte ptr [edx + 0x4A] at 0x6F014D — used to compute the IMUL array index.

fields.name: m_fSuspensionForceLevel
fields.note: Suspension spring force.

fields.name: m_fSuspensionDampingLevel
fields.note: Suspension damping constant.

fields.name: m_fSuspensionHighSpdComDamp
fields.note: High-speed suspension compression damping.

fields.name: m_fSuspensionUpperLimit
fields.note: Upper suspension limit (max wheel extension upward).

fields.name: m_fSuspensionLowerLimit
fields.note: Lower suspension limit (max wheel droop downward).

fields.name: m_fSuspensionFrontRearBias
fields.note: Front/rear suspension bias.

fields.name: m_fSuspensionAntiDiveMultiplier
fields.note: Anti-dive/squat multiplier (prevents nose dive under braking).

fields.name: m_fCollisionDamageMult
fields.note: Collision damage multiplier.

fields.name: m_nModelFlags
fields.note: Model flags bitfield (handling.cfg flags1).

fields.name: m_nHandlingFlags
fields.note: Handling flags bitfield (handling.cfg flags2). See handling_flags_bits below.

fields.name: m_nFrontWheels
fields.note: Front wheel type index (used to select wheel model).

fields.name: m_nRearWheels
fields.note: Rear wheel type index.

fields.name: m_fSeatOffsetDist
fields.note: Seat offset distance (camera distance from seat). fmul dword ptr [eax+0xC8] seen at 0x6F0F47.

fields.name: m_nAnimGroup
fields.note: Animation group index for driver/passenger animations.

fields.name: m_fSteeringInputLock
fields.note: Steering input limit. fld dword ptr [esi+0xD8] at 0x6F0F41.

fields.name: UNKNOWN_0xDC
fields.note: mov eax, dword ptr [esi+0xDC] at 0x6F105C. Likely a pointer or flags field near end of struct.

handling_flags_bits.description: Bits of m_nHandlingFlags (offset 0x74). Source: handling.cfg documentation + exe context.

bits.0x00000002: NOFADE (no fade to black on respawn)
bits.0x00000080: REVERSE_BONNET (boot at front — reversed bonnet open)
bits.0x00000200: SIT_IN_BOAT (driver sits in boat — underwater camera clip)
bits.0x00002000: IS_BIG (big vehicle — affects ped ragdoll knockback)
bits.0x00008000: WHEEL_F_MOVE (front wheel movement — motorcycle or trike)
bits.0x00040000: HAS_ROOF (has a fixed/solid roof — opposite of HAS_NO_ROOF)
bits.0x00400000: TANK (tank — immune to normal crash damage)
bits.0x10000000: STEER_REARWHEELS (rear wheel steering — forklift, some bikes)

community_comparison.prior_art: The handling.cfg text-format field order and names are well-known in the modding community. What was NOT documented before: the exact binary struct offsets for each field, the size of 0xE0 bytes (previously community estimated 0xD4 based on incomplete reverse engineering), the proven array base VA of 0xC2B9DC, the separate sub-handling array at 0xC3BB00 (0x94 bytes), and the CVehicleModelInfo[+0x4A] byte as the array index lookup.
novel_findings: CHandlingData size = 0xE0 (224) bytes — proven cold from imul stride; community had 0xD4 (212)
ms_vehicleHandling array base VA = 0xC2B9DC proven from exe
Sub-handling array at 0xC3BB00, stride 0x94 bytes — never documented
CVehicleModelInfo[+0x4A] = handling index byte — novel finding from index computation path
